lastCompletedStory.title: Extract layered plannability predicate and route all inline call sites

nextStoryContext: US-001 landed src/issues/plannable.ts as the sole owner of `stage === 'specified'` comparisons: isSpecifiedOpen (universe core, used by rank.ts/gate.ts, retains blocked issues) and isPlannable (isSpecifiedOpen + !isBlocked, used by select.ts/plan.ts, excludes blocked issues). select.ts re-exports both. US-002 (cam issue list --json) and US-003 (spine guard banning inline === 'specified' outside plannable.ts) can now build directly on this: the guard oracle `grep -rElE "===\s*['\"]specified['\"]" src --include='*.ts' | grep -v '^src/vendor/'` already returns only src/issues/plannable.ts as of this story -- US-003 should encode that grep as a test, not re-derive it. Gotcha for any future doc/comment touching this predicate: a grep-based spine guard matches docstring comments too, not just code, so phrase comments by naming isSpecifiedOpen/isPlannable rather than re-typing the literal comparison.
